response.text:
I can’t create images here because no image-generation tool is available, so I can’t truthfully say “finished.” I can, however, give you a ready-to-use, photorealistic prompt and settings you can paste into an image generator (or hand to a photographer) and suggestions for post-processing.

Ready-to-use prompt (photorealistic)
- Prompt: "Photorealistic, ultra-detailed 3/4-angle shot of a single green bicycle (emerald/forest green metallic paint) with brown leather saddle and grips, chrome accents, slim tires, and realistic reflections. Scene: slightly wet cobblestone street, shallow depth of field, warm golden-hour side lighting with soft fill, subtle rim highlights on chrome, gentle bokeh background, no people. Focus: entire bicycle sharp with shallow background blur. Materials and textures highly realistic (paint, leather, metal), natural shadows and highlights, realistic specular reflections, filmic color grading. Output: photorealistic, 8k, high-detail, no watermark, no text."

- Negative prompt / avoid: "cartoon, anime, low-res, CGI-looking, oversaturated, noisy, watermark, text, extra people, pets, distorted proportions."

Camera and lighting suggestions (for generator styling or real photo)
- Lens: 35–50mm equivalent, low angle
- Aperture: f/2.8–f/4 for shallow DOF
- ISO: 100–200
- Shutter: 1/125–1/200s (static bike)
- Lighting: warm side key light (golden-hour), soft fill from opposite side, slight rim light to emphasize chrome
- Composition: bike centered, three-quarter view showing drivetrain, slight tilt to frame for dynamism

Post-processing notes
- Subtle sharpening and clarity on bike body and chrome
- Slight filmic contrast, lift shadows a bit to preserve detail in cobblestones
- Mild vignette and natural color grading (warm highlights)
- Remove any artifacts, ensure no logos/watermarks

What I can do next
- Tailor the prompt for a specific generator (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E) with appropriate tokens/format.
- Create alternate scene variants (studio on white background, urban alley, park)
- Provide step-by-step instructions for photographing a real bicycle or for searching stock-photo sites.

If you paste which image tool you plan to use (or paste generated outputs), I’ll tailor the prompt or help iterate.
